name: Neil Forrester
source:
Neil is wealthy, prickly, and doesn't really want to interact with you. 

When you met Neil in your childhood – a memory he's very fond of – he mistook you for a boy. Now that you're an adult, he doesn't quite know how to deal with you. Be whisked away in his awkward charms, visiting masquerade balls and the opera.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939330/Tailor_Tales/]Steam[/url]]
